Nora (sec): Heads-up: our daily image canary started failing at the signing step after the attestation job changes landed. Appears to be an IAM binding removed from the signing key. Logging thread here for coordination.
Ethan (eng-infra): i'm looking at the infra PR. I tightened some bindings to remove legacy principals; maybe i dropped the CI builder binding by mistake.
Rita (eng-runtime): what's the immediate error?
Nora (sec): cosign client shows: ```cosign: upload failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = request missing permission kms.cryptoKeys.encrypt```
kms-agent: [automated] 3 KMS_DENIED events for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/sign-main detected at 1745550122. Callers: ci-builder-sa, canary-runner.
Ethan (eng-infra): audit diff confirms: removed serviceAccount:ci-builder-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for that cryptoKey. I'll reapply a key-scoped binding immediately and annotate it as emergency.
Cal (sre): prefer scoped grant only on the specific cryptoKey and add an IAM condition to limit by `request.time` or by `principal` if possible. We should avoid project-level restores.
Rita (eng-runtime): when you restore, i'll run a staged canary with `--annotations canary=true` so traces and metrics don't get mixed. Also we'll have the runtime refuse unsigned images by default.
Ethan (eng-infra): reapplying now. note: our infra tooling doesn't automate TTL revokes yet; i'll add a PR comment to manually revoke after canary.
kms-agent: [automated] IAM update: added roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to serviceAccount:ci-builder-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com on cryptoKey sign-main at 1745550368. Forwarding to SIEM.
Ethan (eng-infra): PR comment: "temporary, scoped restore to unblock canary. follow-up: automation for ephemeral grants and stricter rotation dry-run checks."
Rita (eng-runtime): kicked off canary sign job -> `cosign: signature upload OK`. runtime accepted image and marked as signed.
Cal (sre): i'll add an alert rule: if KMS.PERMISSION_DENIED > 1 in 20m -> post to #eng-security and create an incident stub. Also forwarding IAM delta + denies to splunk for retention.
Nora (sec): follow-ups: 1) add a small CI preflight `verify_kms_binding.sh` that queries the key IAM and fails fast before attempting to sign; 2) update rotation/cleanup scripts so they run a dry-run and skip removing bindings that match builder principals unless explicitly approved; 3) create a ticket to design ephemeral key access (short-lived grants via an approval flow) and 4) document emergency approvers + revoke steps in the signing runbook.
Ethan (eng-infra): opening PR for the preflight script now. will tag infra owners and include the IAM diff in the incident channel.
Rita (eng-runtime): adding a canary-only annotation handler so we can filter runtime propagation and avoid promoting canary images until we get green sign verification.
Cal (sre): SIEM received events. creating `#inc-image-kms-bind` and adding runbook with action items.
Nora (sec): thanks team. No customer-facing impact. We'll close once preflight is in CI and the revocation TODO is complete. :white_check_mark:
